content.name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
entries: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, poisons have no effect on you. You are immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition and have immunity to poison damage.

content.name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
entries: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition and Poison damage.
